name: comp-318
title: Sticky Footer Dialog
description: A trigger opens a narrow, tall dialog full of FAQ paragraphs. The body scrolls on its own while an outlined Cancel and a white Okay stay fixed in a bordered footer.
use: A dialog holds long copy but its action buttons must stay reachable while the body scrolls.
avoid: The body is a wall of placeholder FAQ text, so it needs replacing before it can ship.
a11y: The dialog primitive traps focus and Escape closes it, but the file itself has no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Closed, a single outlined button. Open, a tall dark rounded dialog: a left-aligned FAQ heading, dense small paragraphs under bold subheads, and a divider over a footer with outlined Cancel and white Okay at the right.
behaves: The trigger opens the dialog over a dimmed page. Scrolling moves only the body text while the footer stays put; Cancel, Okay, Escape or an outside click closes it.
customise: Title, FAQ copy and footer labels are written in the file; nothing is exposed as props.
weight: light: One dialog with native scrolling and no animation beyond its opening fade.
